newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens factory unit growth slows.
newsitem.headline: Siemens factory unit growth slows.

text.p: Business volume growth at Siemens AG's industrial and building systems division slowed to under five percent in the year ended September 30 from seven percent the year before, division chief executive Konrad Pernstich told journalists on Friday.
But growth did not stagnate at Siemens third-largest division, he said, adding that incoming orders rose "strongly" from the 9.7 billion marks seen in 1994/95.
Siemens is due to announce preliminary results for 1995/96 on November 6.
The division's goal is to grow more strongly than the overall market for factory electrical equipment, which is seen expanding five percent annually through the year 2000, Pernstich said.
The division is following its parent company's lead in moving more of its operations outside Germany, particularly to Asia and Latin America.
About 70 percent of its 39,000 employees now work in Germany, and a similar percentage of its business is domestic.
